description: All-day wellness per day over a date range, for trends: resting / min / max heart rate, Body Battery (max, min, charged, drained), average and max stress, intensity minutes, steps, calories burned (total / active) and respiration, plus average / min / max of each field in `summary`. Defaults to the last 7 days; at most 92 days per call. Today's row is partial. For sleep and HRV over a range use garmin_get_sleep_summaries and garmin_get_hrv_summaries, or garmin_get_days for everything per day.

end_date.description: Last day (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today, or 6 days after start_date (not past today).

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD in the user's time zone. Default: 6 days before end_date. At most 92 days per call.

name: garmin_get_daily_summaries
title: Get Garmin daily summaries
